convert_kilt_to_fairseq_dataset: convert a KILT dataset to Fairseq format by extracting provenance titles with bleu score above 0.5
run_convert_kilt_cli: run the script with an input KILT JSONL filename and output directory path to convert datasets
create_input_with_delimiters: create an input representation from a KILT document using START_ENT and END_ENT delimiters with max length 384
extract_template_questions: extract template questions from KILT document metadata and pair them with provenance titles as source-target pairs
sanitize_newlines_in_output: sanitize carriage returns and newlines in source and target data before writing to output files
